caption: The drawing depicts a flat, dark-gray silhouette of a human figure in profile view, oriented toward the left side of the image. The figure is holding a large, curved bow with both hands and is posed as if drawing an arrow, although no arrow is visible. The legs are bent, suggesting movement, with the left leg in front and the right leg behind and partially extended. The figure’s head is adorned with a large headdress that has multiple pointed, feather-like extensions fanning backwards. There are three distinct circular holes in the torso area, one at the shoulder, one near the waist, and a larger one at the center. A straight, vertical rod extends downward from the figure’s lower body. The background is a plain, light beige, and the rectangular border surrounds the entire composition. There is a small, numbered scale at the bottom left corner denoting inches, and the name "Rollington Campbell" is printed near the bottom right. Handwritten numbers and letters appear in the bottom right corner outside the image border.
title: Weather Vane (Indian)
